audience: ecommerce store owners who sell print-on-demand products with Printful

useCases.title: Track your orders and their shipments
useCases.text: The AI lists orders by status, such as pending or fulfilled, and opens one to show its status, items, costs and shipments with carrier and tracking links.

useCases.title: Review sales, costs and profit for a period
useCases.text: The AI reads store statistics for a period of up to 6 months, with sales, costs, profit and order counts, and explains how the store did.

useCases.title: Browse the catalog and its variants
useCases.text: The AI lists catalog categories and products, and opens a product with its variants, sizes, colors, prices and stock.

useCases.title: Quote shipping and estimate the cost of an order
useCases.text: The AI quotes shipping options and delivery estimates to an address and estimates item, print, shipping and tax costs. Nothing is created.

useCases.title: Find synced products that still need a design
useCases.text: The AI lists products imported from a Shopify, Etsy or WooCommerce store and filters those that are unsynced, then opens one to show its sync variants.

useCases.title: Upload a design, make mockups and a draft order
useCases.text: The AI adds a print file from a URL, generates product mockups, and creates a draft order. A draft is not charged until you confirm it in Printful.
